notes.credit_cards: Balances are paid in full every month. No interest carried. These are rolling monthly expenses, not problematic debt.
notes.savings_fund_categories: For fund categories (Down Payment Fund, Vacation Fund, Emergency Fund, etc.), 'budgeted' means money earmarked/set aside—this is saving. 'Activity/spent' means money drawn from the fund for its intended use. Budgeted is good; activity is spending down savings.
